codeState.hashBoundary: The final freeze cannot name its own future commit SHA. The benchmarkSourceAndConfig hash records the exact source and package/config files used for the locked-test run; freeze.json and change-control.md are outside that hash boundary.

commandTemplates.authoritativeLockedTest: npm run trace -- benchmark --partition locked-test --runner all --out eval/benchmark/runs --run-id <locked-test-run-id> --freeze eval/benchmark/freeze.json
commandTemplates.exploratoryLockedTest: npm run trace -- benchmark --partition locked-test --runner all --out <scratch-artifact-root> --run-id <exploratory-run-id> --freeze eval/benchmark/freeze.json --exploratory

environmentAssumptions.network: No network access is required or allowed for runners, scoring, aggregation, or freeze validation.
environmentAssumptions.timezone: Benchmark runner timing is deterministic UTC metadata; local timezone must not affect scoring.
environmentAssumptions.secrets: No secrets or external account credentials are required for the benchmark run.

allowedVolatileFields.reason: The locked-test run ID may be supplied at execution time, but it must be recorded and must not alter source, fixtures, annotations, scoring, config, or weights.
The artifact root may vary between authoritative reproduction and local scratch runs; artifact content is still derived from frozen inputs.
Current deterministic runners emit stable timing, but timing metadata is non-substantive and must not drive scoring config, source, fixture, annotation, or weight changes.
If an environmental failure is recorded, occurrence time may vary; the failure must remain preserved rather than tuned away.

manifest.description: Frozen internal benchmark manifest with one demo case and twelve scored cases.

benchmarkSourceAndConfig.description: Benchmark CLI, input compiler, runners, TRACE wrapper, scorer, aggregation, runtime/reporting dependencies, and npm/TypeScript/lint/test config.

developmentRunArtifacts.description: Post-adjustment development run artifacts used to establish the final pre-freeze development result.

lockedTestPolicy.noTuningStatement: After this freeze, locked-test results may not drive source, fixture, scoring, config, or weight changes.
lockedTestPolicy.authoritativeRunPolicy: An authoritative locked-test run must validate this freeze record before runner execution and must use the frozen manifest, fixtures, annotations, runner/scorer code, scoring weights, command shape, and package/config state.
lockedTestPolicy.exploratoryRunPolicy: A locked-test run with mismatched frozen hashes is allowed only with explicit exploratory mode and is non-authoritative; its results must not be reported as the locked-test benchmark result.
